config.guide_keying: Asymmetric centres(6,30)/(97,28) plus round-left/slotted-right; reversed card cannot seat both guides; pins engage only after guides.

jack.copper_gap_derivation: 14 - (6.48 + 4.92) - (1.83/2 + 2.13/2) = 0.62 mm, nearest sleeve and tip pads on adjacent rows; dimensions from the derived KiCad footprint
jack.note: The F.CrtYd lines add 0.05 mm stroke. Nominal body-to-body vertical gap is 3.5 mm; manufactured tolerances and plug/nut envelopes are unqualified.

body_depth_along_shaft.note: Body depth along shaft direction, not installed height.
body_depth_along_shaft.source_locator: physical PDF page 1, PTV09A-4 side drawing, 6.8 callout

body_height.note: No qualified seated height above the PCB is given for the exact -4 horizontal/rear configuration.

clockwise_end.source_locator: physical PDF page 0, schematic 1–2–3 and full-CCW view; clockwise travel moves wiper toward terminal 3

full_ccw_end.source_locator: physical PDF page 0, schematic and full-CCW drawing; page 1 PTV09A-4 full-CCW view

mounting_leg_pitch.source_locator: physical PDF page 0, horizontal/rear layout; transfer to PTV09A-4 requires first article confirmation

mounting_surface_to_shaft_end.note: PTV09A-4 L=20±0.5 is drawn from a body/shaft datum, not proven PCB mounting-face to tip.

pin_row_pitch.source_locator: physical PDF page 0, horizontal/rear layout, 5.0 mm span over pins 1–3

recommended_panel_hole.note: Bushingless -4 part has no manufacturer recommended panel hole or tolerance in this drawing; project 6.3 mm preview is a proposal.

seated_height.note: Board seating and panel stack need a physical coupon.

shaft_diameter.source_locator: physical PDF page 1, F-Type shaft diagram

shaft_length_L.source_locator: physical PDF page 1 (0-based), PTV09A-4 dimension L; page 1 F-type length table

support_beyond_solder_joints.source_locator: physical PDF page 0, PTV09A-1 horizontal/rear PCB layout; physical PDF page 1, PTV09A-4 side view
support_beyond_solder_joints.value: Two mounting legs shown in family horizontal/rear layout; panel/knob side support not established.

front_source_envelopes.scope: Inherited body/courtyard envelopes and conditional datums; not revised front PCB packing

selector.locator: Drawing No.7: all three dimensions views, mounting holes, circuit diagram
selector.mount_pad_classification: MP1/MP2 are mechanical features absent from electrical circuit; plating is unspecified. Retain PTH diameter 2.6 / drill 2.0, annular ring 0.3. No NPTH reclassification.
selector.terminal_tail_note: Conservative terminal-tail keepout uses Ø0.9 bores around terminal centers as an assembly allowance, not a claim of Ø0.9 solid pins. Main asymmetric body ends at y=+8 but the terminal row is y=+9.15.
selector.uncertainty: 18.2 span retained as full-width conservative envelope; no exact solid contour inferred. 18.3 terminal rows centered on indicated shaft centerline by drawing symmetry (dimension to each row not individually toleranced). No general body, tail, hole-position or bushing tolerance given.

limitations: Shelf placement proves courtyard capacity and axial approach only; not routing, thermal, EMI or native solid fit.

Front-source package assignments conserved; redesigned front PCB copper/solids and seated datums still future one-zone work.
Support stiffness and connector alignment/proof load need prototype tests.
